headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Gross profit increased 31.1% YoY to INR 1,382 cr, with gross margin expanding by 110 bps to 46.0%, aided by a higher House of Nykaa share and higher marketing income.
EBITDA rose 65.2% YoY and 11.2% QoQ to INR 263 cr, with margin expanding by 190 bps YoY to 8.7%, supported by efficiencies in marketing and overheads, operating leverage and improving unit economics.
PAT increased 206.8% YoY and 26.9% QoQ to INR 101 cr, with margin improving to 3.4% from 1.4% in Q2FY26, driven by strong EBITDA growth.
Beauty remained the key growth and profitability driver, while Fashion stayed EBITDA positive for the third straight quarter.
valuation: Nykaa Now expanded to 15 cities with 1,000+ brands, targeting 25+ cities by FY27.
Nykaa also partnered with L’Oréal BOLD to invest in emerging Indian beauty brands, while AI-led personalization and targeting continued to lift conversion and lower CAC.
Valuation call – We recommend a HOLD rating at the CMP of INR 350, with price target of INR 384 (56X FY29 EV/EBITDA), representing an upside of 9.6%.
watch: Beauty remained the key growth and profitability driver, while Fashion stayed EBITDA positive for the third straight quarter.
Beauty brands delivered Q2 NSV of INR 535 cr (+39% YoY), led by Dot & Key, Kay Beauty and Nykaa Cosmetics, with annualized NSV run-rates of INR 1,300 cr, INR 350 cr and INR 300 cr, respectively.
